obligations.name: interior_benchmark_growth
obligations.statement: If d <= c M2 and M2 <= 1/c^2, q=d/(2M2) is feasible and growth >= c^2 d^2/4.

obligations.statement: For either benchmark, Var(g) is no larger than its quadratic log-growth lower bound.

obligations.method: Strong law for bounded iid log increments plus the exact regret-to-wealth inequality.
obligations.name: asymptotic_power
obligations.statement: Positive iid benchmark mean and o(t) pathwise regret imply log S_t/t has positive liminf almost surely.

obligations.method: Direct substitution c=mu/2 in Bernstein with B=32+(4/3)log 3.
obligations.name: bernstein_tail
obligations.statement: Var(log increment)<=4mu and range<=log 3 give P(tau>t)<=exp(-t mu/B).

obligations.name: stopping_time_order
obligations.statement: mu>=c^2 d^2/4 yields O(d^-2 log(1/(alpha d))+d^-2) for fixed c.

obligations.method: Equation 8 and C_k are continuous in k at zero for eta!=0 on compact p in [0,1].
